subject.description: VID of the subject granting consent.

processor.description: VID of the data processor receiving consent.

scope.description: Opaque scope identifiers the consent covers.

purpose.description: Human-readable description of the processing purpose.

expiresAt.description: Optional consent expiry (distinct from the document's framework-level expiresAt).

revocation.description: Endpoint the subject can use to revoke this consent.
